> Set `injectWarm: true` for special c"},{"id":"p23s4","text":"ases (empty cold store, needing recent context inline)."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"## Engineering guardrails (v0.2)"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"Memory *timing* is infrastructure, so it is enforced by code, not by prompting:"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"- **End-of-turn assessment** — on every `turn/end`, the plugin asks the model once whether the turn "},{"id":"p26s2","text":"produced anything worth keeping (`fact` / `decision` / `preference` / `experience`). Worthwhile entr"},{"id":"p26s3","text":"ies are appended to warm memory automatically; `SKIP` is emitted when nothing qualifies. This no lon"},{"id":"p26s4","text":"ger depends on the model remembering to call `memory_append` on its own.

The model never hits a full-"},{"id":"p26s7","text":"memory error and never has to schedule consolidation itself."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"Both can be tuned under the `linghun.memory.assessment` / `linghun.memory.autoConsolidate` settings "},{"id":"p27s2","text":"(each with an `enabled` switch), e.g. through `cordis.patch.yml`."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"## Roadmap"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"- **v0.1.0** (done): identity + judgment + hippocampus
